# Bitfroest.fs 0.0.54

Changes since version [0.0.53](https://github.com/s-a/Bitfroest.fs/releases/tag/v0.0.53).

## Added

- **Send to** in the Bitfroest file context menu lists configured favorites. Choose a favorite and select **Copy** or **Move** to open the standard transfer dialog with that destination filled in. The optional Windows system context menu has its own entries.

## Improved

- The file manager button appears on the left side of the VS Code Status Bar.

## Fixed

- Deleting a file while its folder is still loading keeps the remaining files visible. No manual refresh is needed.
- **Copy Details** includes the available transfer context when a file operation fails. It shortens recognized paths and preserves stack frame locations. The details can include the error code and the last confirmed step.
- **Send to** can move a folder into a favorite that already contains a folder with the same name. On Windows, the merge also handles names that differ only in capitalization. It keeps destination-only files and prompts for file conflicts.
- Folder merges tolerate concurrent changes to unrelated destination files. If directory timestamps are missing during a source scan, the file manager verifies the directory entries directly.
- Transfer progress uses the known total size of selected files across write sections and conflict prompts. The current file has a separate indicator. Skipped files are removed from the planned byte total.
- Copy and move execute the confirmed source and destination paths. Unrelated open or cached folders no longer take part in transfer validation. Preparation errors identify the blocking folder and the check that failed.
- Copy, move and delete update affected entries in open folder tabs without relisting the folders.
- The activity log records transfer decisions, user cancellation requests and outcomes. The status bar indicates when no files or folders were transferred.
- Native Windows transfers deliver file and section progress through the scoped transfer contract. A progress delivery failure is reported as an error with its cause.

## Updating

Update Bitfroest.fs through the VS Code Extensions view on the pre-release channel. Packages are built for Windows x64 and Linux x64. The Apple Silicon package remains experimental.
